notes: Summary: Enterprise analytics platform; heavy vector search + reranking workload; strong AWS footprint (prod infra on AWS).
Initial ask: embeddings at scale (500 qps), reranking for top-K results, chat feature with p95 < 250ms on user-facing flows.
Security: required SSO/SAML, KMS-managed keys, audit logs, and EU data residency for a subset of datasets — asked for SOC2 evidence during security review.
POC: ran 3-week POC; compared Redwood hosted plan vs AWS SageMaker endpoints. Redwood demo was strong on latency but procurement flagged total cost of ownership and vendor consolidation.
Quotes: CIO (Jan 22) - "We need fewer commercial vendors on our cloud bill + better enterprise discounts."

Procurement decision: chose AWS SageMaker-managed endpoints. Primary reasons: existing enterprise AWS discount commitments, internal ops familiarity, perceived lower integration effort with current infra.
Sales notes: discovered lack of an internal champion after CTIO left in Dec — slowed exec approvals and timeline slipped multiple times.
Follow-up: set reminder for infra refresh cycle in Q3 2026; recommended targeting orgs with multi-cloud strategy next time.
